description: Kartikeya bwrap mount policy (product-neutral default). Override via $KART_SANDBOX_CONFIG or $WILLOW_HOME/kart-sandbox.json to add host/fleet-specific paths without editing code.

_security_notes.github_ro: ~/github is read-only, and WILLOW_ROOT is read-only WITH it. Only the work root ({{WILLOW_ROOT}}/worktrees) and discovered worktrees nest read-write on top. Hosts promote additional repos to RW via an override config.
_security_notes.ssh_dropped: ~/.ssh is not bound. SSH git uses SSH_AUTH_SOCK (via /run/user) + known_hosts (ro), both only on allow_net. Private keys never enter the sandbox.
_security_notes.creds_gated: credential_env_prefixes (and ~/.config/gh, ~/.netrc) are present only on allow_net. A no-network task gets zero credentials.
_security_notes.db_gated: db_env_prefixes and /var/run/postgresql socket bind are present only on allow_db. Default tasks cannot reach the local Postgres lane.
_security_notes.localhost_tier: # allow_localhost shares the host network namespace (loopback works) but still strips credentials. Weaker than --unshare-net; prefer over allow_net for local-only work.
_security_notes.tmp_tmpfs: /tmp + /dev/shm are private tmpfs, not host binds.
_security_notes.work_root_is_not_the_product: WILLOW_ROOT resolves to the product's source on a developer box and to the installed package tree on a pip install. Bound read-write it let a sandboxed task edit the code that decides what tasks may do — measured 2026-09-02 on a live box: gate.py (the manifest ACL), pyproject.toml (the kartikeya floor that ships these very overlays), .git and .gitignore were all WRITABLE while mcp_apps/ and consent.json were correctly read-only. The policy files were protected and the code that reads them was not. Tasks now get a work root of their own: WILLOW_ROOT is ro, {{WILLOW_ROOT}}/worktrees is rw, and a task that needs to change source does it in a worktree.
_security_notes.venv_ro: Venvs are bound read-only. .venv-dev is deliberately NOT in bind_try: a writable venv lets a task rewrite the .pth that resolves the product package, which is work_root_is_not_the_product through a different door.
